articles.title: Signal Blocks Screenshots to Fight AI Surveillance
articles.summaryZh: Signal在Android和iOS应用中限制截图功能，以应对AI监控的存在性威胁。

sentences.en: Signal has announced a new privacy measure that blocks users from taking screenshots on both Android and iOS devices.
sentences.zh: Signal宣布一项新的隐私措施，阻止用户在Android和iOS设备上截图。
sentences.tip: 主干：Signal announced a new privacy measure；听：注意短语blocks users from taking screenshots的弱读。

sentences.en: The change comes as the messaging app faces growing concerns about AI-powered surveillance tools that could capture private conversations.
sentences.zh: 此举是因为该消息应用面临越来越多关于AI驱动监控工具可能捕获私人对话的担忧。
sentences.tip: 主干：The change comes as；听：关注AI-powered surveillance的连读。

sentences.en: Signal’s CEO, Daniel M. Barrett, said the decision is a proactive step to protect user privacy.
sentences.zh: Signal的CEO Daniel M. Barrett表示，这一决定是主动保护用户隐私的步骤。
sentences.tip: 主干：Signal’s CEO said the decision is a proactive step；听：注意proactive step的弱读。

sentences.en: The app will still allow text messages to be copied, but screenshots of group chats and media will be disabled.
sentences.zh: 该应用仍允许复制文本消息，但会禁用群聊和媒体的截图。
sentences.tip: 主干：The app will still allow；听：关注still allow的连读。

sentences.en: Users who try to capture a screenshot will see an error message explaining the restriction.
sentences.zh: 尝试截图的用户会看到解释限制的错误信息。
sentences.tip: 主干：Users who try to capture a screenshot will see；听：注意capture a screenshot的弱读。

sentences.en: Signal’s move follows a broader industry trend where apps are tightening security to curb data misuse.
sentences.zh: Signal的举措跟随行业更广泛的趋势，应用正在加强安全以遏制数据滥用。
sentences.tip: 主干：Signal’s move follows；听：关注broader industry trend的连读。

sentences.en: Experts say that limiting screenshots may reduce the risk of private chats being leaked through third‑party apps.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，限制截图可能降低私人聊天通过第三方应用泄露的风险。
sentences.tip: 主干：Experts say that limiting screenshots may reduce；听：注意limiting screenshots的弱读。

sentences.en: The feature will roll out over the next few weeks, with updates expected for both Android and iOS platforms.
sentences.zh: 该功能将在接下来几周内推出，预计Android和iOS平台将更新。
sentences.tip: 主干：The feature will roll out；听：关注roll out的连读。

sentences.en: Signal users can continue to enjoy end‑to‑end encryption, which remains the app’s core security promise.
sentences.zh: Signal用户仍可享受端到端加密，这是该应用的核心安全承诺。
sentences.tip: 主干：Signal users can continue to enjoy；听：注意end‑to‑end encryption的弱读。

sentences.en: If you’re concerned about privacy, it’s worth checking the app’s settings to ensure your data stays protected.
sentences.zh: 如果你关心隐私，值得检查应用设置，确保数据安全。
sentences.tip: 主干：If you’re concerned about privacy；听：关注check the app’s settings的连读。

quiz.q: What new feature has Signal introduced to protect user privacy?
options: It has added a new encryption method
It has blocked the ability to take screenshots
quiz.explainZh: Signal限制截图功能，以防止私人对话被捕获。

quiz.q: Which type of content will still be allowed to be copied in Signal?
quiz.explainZh: Signal仍允许复制文本消息，但禁用群聊和媒体截图。

articles.title: AI and a Human Offer New Solutions to Riemann Hypothesis
articles.titleZh: AI与人类提出新的黎曼猜想解法
articles.summaryZh: AI提出了一个可能的解法，随后一名数学家也给出了类似的答案。

sentences.en: Scientists are stunned by a new AI-generated proof that could solve the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 科学家们对一份由人工智能生成的可能解决167年历史的黎曼猜想的证明感到震惊。
sentences.tip: 主干：Scientists are stunned by a new AI-generated proof; 听：注意弱化的“are stunned”。

focus.note: 常用来形容机器产生的结论

sentences.en: The AI model, trained on thousands of mathematical papers, identified a pattern that had eluded researchers for decades.
sentences.zh: 该人工智能模型在数千篇数学论文的训练下，发现了一个长期困扰研究者的模式。
sentences.tip: 主干：The AI model identified a pattern; 听：关注连读和弱化的“model trained”。

sentences.en: Within hours, a mathematician named Dr. Li announced a similar solution based on traditional analytical techniques.
sentences.zh: 几小时内，一位名叫李博士的数学家宣布了一个基于传统分析技术的类似解法。
sentences.tip: 主干：Dr. Li announced a similar solution; 听：注意名词短语的连读。

sentences.en: Both proofs rely on advanced calculus and complex analysis, but the AI's approach uses machine learning to test thousands of possibilities.
sentences.zh: 两份证明都依赖高级微积分和复分析，但人工智能的方法使用机器学习测试数千种可能性。
sentences.tip: 主干：Both proofs rely on advanced calculus; 听：注意连读和弱化的“both proofs”。

sentences.en: The mathematical community is debating whether the AI's proof meets the rigorous standards of peer review.
sentences.zh: 数学界正在争论人工智能的证明是否符合同行评议的严格标准。
sentences.tip: 主干：The mathematical community is debating; 听：注意弱化的“community”。

sentences.en: If accepted, this could be the first time a computer has contributed a major theorem to mathematics.
sentences.zh: 如果被接受，这将可能是计算机首次为数学贡献重大定理。
sentences.tip: 主干：If accepted, this could be the first time; 听：注意条件句的弱化。

sentences.en: The results also raise questions about the role of AI in future research and how to verify machine-generated proofs.
sentences.zh: 这些结果也提出了关于人工智能在未来研究中的作用以及如何验证机器生成证明的问题。
sentences.tip: 主干：The results also raise questions; 听：注意连读和弱化的“results”。

sentences.en: Experts say that both human and AI solutions must undergo thorough peer review before any claim is accepted.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，人工和人工智能的解法都必须经过彻底的同行评议，才能被接受。
sentences.tip: 主干：Experts say that both human and AI solutions must undergo; 听：注意弱化的“both”。

sentences.en: In the coming weeks, journals will publish detailed analyses and the mathematics community will decide the final verdict.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周内，期刊将发布详细分析，数学界将决定最终判决。
sentences.tip: 主干：In the coming weeks, journals will publish; 听：注意连读和弱化的“journals”。

sentences.en: Stay tuned for updates as the debate continues and the implications of AI in mathematics unfold.
sentences.zh: 请关注后续更新，了解争论继续以及人工智能在数学中的影响如何展开。
sentences.tip: 主干：Stay tuned for updates; 听：注意弱化的“stay tuned”。

quiz.q: What is the main claim of the AI-generated proof?
options: It is unrelated to the Riemann hypothesis
It is a new mathematical field
quiz.explainZh: AI声称它可能解决了黎曼猜想。

quiz.q: Which field is NOT mentioned as part of the proofs?
quiz.explainZh: 文中没有提到量子物理。

articles.title: OpenAI Tackles Adversarial Distillation with Layered Defense
articles.titleZh: OpenAI 通过分层防御应对对抗性蒸馏
articles.summaryZh: OpenAI 采用多层防御策略，结合模型训练、保障措施、检测和执法，防止能力被提取。

sentences.en: OpenAI has announced a new strategy to stop adversarial distillation, a technique that steals model knowledge.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 宣布了一项新策略，阻止对抗性蒸馏，这是一种窃取模型知识的技术。

focus.note: 指窃取模型知识的技术

sentences.en: The approach combines four layers: model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement.
sentences.zh: 该方法结合了四个层面：模型训练、保障措施、检测和执法。

sentences.en: First, OpenAI trains models with built‑in resistance to extraction attacks.
sentences.zh: 首先，OpenAI 在模型训练中加入了对提取攻击的抗性。

sentences.en: Second, the company implements safeguards that limit how much information a user can request.
sentences.zh: 其次，公司实施了保障措施，限制用户可以请求的信息量。

sentences.en: Third, OpenAI deploys automated detection tools that flag suspicious patterns in user queries.
sentences.zh: 第三，OpenAI 部署了自动检测工具，标记用户查询中的可疑模式。

sentences.en: Finally, the organization enforces usage policies by blocking or throttling accounts that violate rules.
sentences.zh: 最后，组织通过阻止或限速违反规则的账户来执行使用政策。

sentences.en: This layered defense is designed to make it harder for attackers to extract useful data from the model.
sentences.zh: 这种分层防御旨在使攻击者更难从模型中提取有用数据。

sentences.en: OpenAI’s strategy follows a broader industry trend toward secure AI deployment.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 的策略符合行业更广泛的安全 AI 部署趋势。

sentences.en: The company will release detailed technical papers next month to help researchers understand the methods.
sentences.zh: 公司将在下个月发布详细技术论文，帮助研究人员了解这些方法。

sentences.en: Users and developers should stay informed about these updates to ensure compliance and protection.
sentences.zh: 用户和开发者应关注这些更新，以确保合规和安全。

quiz.q: What is the main purpose of OpenAI's new strategy?
quiz.explainZh: 该策略旨在阻止对抗性蒸馏，防止模型知识被窃取。

quiz.q: Which layer is NOT part of OpenAI's defense?
quiz.explainZh: 数据加密未被列为四个防御层之一。

articles.title: Anthropic Goes Public: Can It Prioritize Safety?
articles.titleZh: Anthropic上市：能否把安全放在首位？
articles.summaryZh: Anthropic的AI实验室Claude上市，讨论其是否能在盈利与安全之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI model, has just listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange.
sentences.zh: Anthropic，Claude AI模型的背后公司，刚刚在纳斯达克上市。
sentences.tip: 主干：Anthropic ... listed on the Nasdaq；听：注意连读和弱化的冠词。

sentences.en: The IPO raised billions of dollars, but the exact figures are not the focus of today’s discussion.
sentences.zh: 首次公开募股筹集了数十亿美元，但今天的讨论重点不是具体数字。
sentences.tip: 主干：The IPO raised billions; 听：注意强读的“raised”。

sentences.en: Hayden Field, a senior AI reporter for The Verge, is speaking with the company’s executives about future plans.
sentences.zh: The Verge的高级AI记者Hayden Field正与公司高管交谈未来计划。
sentences.tip: 主干：Hayden Field ... speaking with ... executives；听：注意名词短语的连读。

sentences.en: One key question is whether Anthropic can maintain a strong focus on safety while also meeting investor expectations.
sentences.zh: 一个关键问题是Anthropic是否能在满足投资者期望的同时，保持对安全的强烈关注。
sentences.tip: 主干：One key question ... can maintain a strong focus on safety；听：注意“can maintain”的弱化。

focus.text: maintain a strong focus on safety
focus.meaning: 保持对安全的强烈关注

sentences.en: The company has already announced plans to invest heavily in safety research and development.
sentences.zh: 该公司已宣布计划在安全研发上大量投资。
sentences.tip: 主干：The company ... announced plans to invest heavily; 听：注意“invest heavily”的连读。

focus.meaning: 在安全研发上大量投资

sentences.en: Experts say that balancing profit and safety is a major challenge for all AI firms in the market.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，在市场上，平衡利润与安全是所有AI公司面临的主要挑战。
sentences.tip: 主干：Experts say ... balancing profit and safety is a major challenge；听：注意“balancing”的弱化。

sentences.en: Anthropic’s leadership believes that a clear safety roadmap will help attract long‑term investors.
sentences.zh: Anthropic的领导层认为，明确的安全路线图有助于吸引长期投资者。
sentences.tip: 主干：Anthropic’s leadership ... believes that a clear safety roadmap；听：注意“long‑term investors”的连读。

sentences.en: The company will release more detailed financial forecasts next month, which will be closely watched by analysts.
sentences.zh: 公司将在下个月公布更详细的财务预测，分析师将密切关注。
sentences.tip: 主干：The company will release ... next month；听：注意“release more detailed”的弱化。

focus.meaning: 公布更详细的财务预测

sentences.en: Investors and regulators alike will be watching to see if Anthropic can deliver on its safety promises.
sentences.zh: 投资者和监管机构都将关注Anthropic是否能兑现其安全承诺。
sentences.tip: 主干：Investors and regulators alike ... watching to see if ...；听：注意“watching to see”。

quiz.q: What is the main concern discussed about Anthropic's IPO?
quiz.explainZh: 讨论的重点是公司能否在盈利与安全之间取得平衡。

quiz.q: Who is speaking with Anthropic's executives?
quiz.explainZh: The Verge的高级AI记者Hayden Field正在与高管交谈。

articles.title: Nvidia’s Earnings vs. Calls for CEO Return
articles.titleZh: 英伟达：财报与CEO回归呼声
articles.summaryZh: 英伟达公布最新财报，业绩表现与行业预期不同；与此同时，部分技术高管公开呼吁CEO黄仁勋重返公司。

sentences.en: Nvidia released its quarterly earnings report, showing higher revenue but lower profit than analysts expected.
sentences.zh: 英伟达公布季度财报，收入较高但利润低于分析师预期。
sentences.tip: 主干：Nvidia released its quarterly earnings report；听：注意连读和弱化的冠词。

sentences.en: The company’s shares fell by about 3 percent in after‑market trading.
sentences.zh: 公司股价在盘后交易中下跌约3%。
sentences.tip: 主干：The company’s shares fell；听：连读的所有格与动词过去式。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, several top tech executives publicly urged Jensen Huang to return as CEO.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，数位顶尖技术高管公开呼吁黄仁勋重返CEO职位。
sentences.tip: 主干：Meanwhile, several top tech executives urged；听：注意连读和弱化的冠词。

sentences.en: They said Huang’s leadership was essential for guiding Nvidia’s AI strategy and maintaining investor confidence.
sentences.zh: 他们表示黄的领导对引导英伟达AI战略和维持投资者信心至关重要。
sentences.tip: 主干：They said Huang’s leadership was essential；听：弱化的冠词和连读。

sentences.en: Nvidia’s board has not yet responded to the executives’ request.
sentences.zh: 英伟达董事会尚未回应高管的请求。
sentences.tip: 主干：Nvidia’s board has not yet responded；听：注意所有格和过去完成时。

sentences.en: Analysts warn that a leadership change could add uncertainty to an already volatile market.
sentences.zh: 分析师警告，领导层变动可能给本已波动的市场增添不确定性。
sentences.tip: 主干：Analysts warn that a leadership change could add；听：弱化的冠词和连读。

sentences.en: The tech community is watching closely, hoping the board will act swiftly to reassure investors.
sentences.zh: 技术界密切关注，希望董事会迅速行动以安抚投资者。
sentences.tip: 主干：The tech community is watching closely；听：连读和弱化的冠词。

sentences.en: Investors will be looking for a formal statement from Nvidia later this week.
sentences.zh: 投资者将会在本周晚些时候关注英伟达的正式声明。
sentences.tip: 主干：Investors will be looking for a formal statement；听：注意未来式和连读。

sentences.en: If the board delays, market volatility could rise, affecting Nvidia’s stock and the broader AI sector.
sentences.zh: 如果董事会延迟，市场波动可能上升，影响英伟达股价和更广泛的AI行业。
sentences.tip: 主干：If the board delays, market volatility could rise；听：连读和弱化的冠词。

sentences.en: Stay tuned for updates as Nvidia’s leadership debate continues to unfold.
sentences.zh: 请持续关注英伟达领导层争论的进一步发展。
sentences.tip: 主干：Stay tuned for updates；听：连读和弱化的冠词。

focus.meaning: 英伟达领导层争论继续

quiz.q: What was the main reason some executives called for Jensen Huang’s return?
quiz.explainZh: 他们认为黄的领导对AI战略至关重要。

quiz.q: How did Nvidia’s stock react after the earnings report?
quiz.explainZh: 股价在盘后交易中下跌约3%。

articles.title: UN Fails to Agree on Rules for Killer Robots
articles.titleZh: 联合国未能就“杀手机器人”制定规则达成一致
articles.summaryZh: 联合国外交官在日内瓦会议上讨论自主武器规则，但未达成协议。

sentences.en: This week, UN diplomats met in Geneva to discuss rules for autonomous weapons, often called killer robots.
sentences.zh: 本周，联合国外交官在日内瓦会面，讨论自主武器的规则，通常称为杀手机器人。
sentences.tip: 主干：UN diplomats met in Geneva to discuss rules；听：注意连读和弱化词。

focus.meaning: 联合国外交官在日内瓦会面

sentences.en: They aimed to create guidelines that would limit how these weapons could be used in armed conflicts.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是制定准则，限制这些武器在武装冲突中的使用方式。
sentences.tip: 主干：They aimed to create guidelines；听：关注动词短语和名词短语。

sentences.en: However, after a week of talks, the diplomats could not agree on any specific rules.
sentences.zh: 然而，经过一周的讨论，外交官们未能就任何具体规则达成一致。
sentences.tip: 主干：could not agree on any specific rules；听：注意否定词和形容词。

sentences.en: They decided instead to start discussing options for future negotiations, hoping to find common ground later.
sentences.zh: 他们决定改为开始讨论未来谈判的选项，希望以后能找到共同点。
sentences.tip: 主干：decided to start discussing options；听：注意动词搭配和连词。

sentences.en: The failure reflects the difficulty of balancing national security interests with global safety concerns.
sentences.zh: 失败反映了平衡国家安全利益与全球安全关切的难度。
sentences.tip: 主干：failure reflects the difficulty；听：注意名词短语的搭配。

sentences.en: Experts say the lack of agreement could slow the development of international norms on autonomous weapons.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，缺乏协议可能会减缓国际自主武器规范的发展。
sentences.tip: 主干：lack of agreement could slow；听：注意情态动词和名词短语。

sentences.en: The United Nations has been working on this issue since 2015, following growing concerns about lethal autonomous systems.
sentences.zh: 自2015年以来，联合国一直在处理此问题，因对致命自主系统的担忧日益增加。
sentences.tip: 主干：United Nations has been working；听：注意现在完成进行时。

sentences.en: Next week, the UN will hold a follow‑up meeting in Geneva to revisit the topic and try new approaches.
sentences.zh: 下周，联合国将在日内瓦举行后续会议，重新审视该主题并尝试新方法。
sentences.tip: 主干：will hold a follow‑up meeting；听：注意未来时和连词。

quiz.q: What was the main goal of the UN diplomats' meeting in Geneva?
options: To create guidelines for autonomous weapons
To increase funding for military research
To train soldiers in using robots
quiz.explainZh: 会议的目标是制定自主武器的准则，而不是全面禁用或增加资金。

articles.title: South Korea Education Minister Resigns Over Exam Cheating Scandal
articles.titleZh: 韩国教育部长因考试作弊丑闻辞职
articles.summaryZh: 韩国教育部长崔奎振因在大学入学考试中实施最后时刻的 AI 作弊防范措施而辞职，事件引发公众关注。

sentences.en: The South Korean education minister, Choi Kyo-jin, resigned yesterday after a scandal involving AI‑assisted cheating at the college entrance exam.
sentences.zh: 韩国教育部长崔奎振因大学入学考试中的 AI 辅助作弊丑闻，于昨日辞职。
sentences.tip: 主干：minister resigned；听：注意弱化动词‘resigned’的弱化音，连读‘after a scandal’。

focus.note: 科技与教育结合的常见说法

sentences.en: Choi admitted that he ordered last‑minute measures to stop cheating, but the plan caused confusion and chaos among students.
sentences.zh: 崔承认他下令实施最后时刻的防作弊措施，但该计划导致学生们混乱不堪。
sentences.tip: 主干：Choi admitted; 听：注意连读‘last‑minute’和‘caused chaos’的弱化。

sentences.en: The exam, held nationwide, is the most important test for students aiming to enter university in South Korea.
sentences.zh: 这场全国性考试是学生进入韩国大学的最重要测试。
sentences.tip: 主干：exam is the most important test；听：注意‘most important’的重读。

sentences.en: The government had previously warned that AI tools could be used by students to cheat, prompting a rapid response.
sentences.zh: 政府此前警告学生可能使用 AI 工具作弊，促使其迅速采取行动。
sentences.tip: 主干：government had warned；听：注意‘rapid response’的连读。

sentences.en: Critics argue that the sudden crackdown was poorly planned and disrupted many students’ preparation.
sentences.zh: 批评者认为突然的打击计划不周，扰乱了许多学生的备考。
sentences.tip: 主干：Critics argue；听：注意‘sudden crackdown’的弱化。

sentences.en: Choi’s resignation follows a series of protests demanding accountability from the education ministry.
sentences.zh: 崔的辞职是在一系列要求教育部承担责任的抗议之后。
sentences.tip: 主干：resignation follows；听：注意‘series of protests’的连读。

sentences.en: The scandal highlights the growing challenge of regulating AI in high‑stakes exams worldwide.
sentences.zh: 这起丑闻凸显了全球在高风险考试中监管 AI 的日益挑战。
sentences.tip: 主干：scandal highlights；听：注意‘high‑stakes exams’的弱化。

sentences.en: The ministry has pledged to review exam security and improve digital monitoring tools.
sentences.zh: 教育部承诺审查考试安全并改进数字监测工具。
sentences.tip: 主干：ministry has pledged；听：注意‘digital monitoring tools’的连读。

sentences.en: Observers will watch how the new policies affect student fairness and the integrity of future exams.
sentences.zh: 观察者将关注新政策如何影响学生公平和未来考试的完整性。
sentences.tip: 主干：observers will watch；听：注意‘student fairness’的弱化。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, students and parents are calling for clearer guidelines on acceptable use of technology during tests.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，学生和家长要求制定更清晰的技术使用准则。
sentences.tip: 主干：students and parents are calling；听：注意‘clearer guidelines’的连读。

quiz.q: What was the main reason Choi Kyo-jin resigned?
quiz.explainZh: 他因在考试中实施最后时刻的反作弊措施导致混乱而辞职。

quiz.q: Which of the following best describes the exam's significance?
options: The most important test for university entry
quiz.explainZh: 这场考试是学生进入大学的最重要考试。

articles.title: Russia‑bound Ship Attacked in Gulf of Finland
articles.titleZh: 俄国航运船只在芬兰湾遭袭
articles.summaryZh: 乌克兰可能使用无人机袭击了驶往俄罗斯的船只，芬兰防卫部队已确认。

sentences.en: A ship heading to Russia was attacked by a drone in the Gulf of Finland.
sentences.zh: 一艘驶往俄罗斯的船只在芬兰湾被无人机袭击。

sentences.en: Finnish defence forces said the attack likely involved Ukrainian drones.
sentences.zh: 芬兰防卫部队表示袭击很可能使用了乌克兰无人机。

sentences.en: The vessel was on a commercial route between Helsinki and St. Petersburg.
sentences.zh: 该船正沿着赫尔辛基至圣彼得堡的商业航线航行。

focus.meaning: 从赫尔辛基到圣彼得堡

sentences.en: No crew members were injured, and the ship remained afloat after the strike.
sentences.zh: 船员没有受伤，船只在袭击后仍保持漂浮。

sentences.en: Finnish authorities are investigating the incident and have requested satellite footage.
sentences.zh: 芬兰当局正在调查此事件，并已请求卫星影像。

sentences.en: The attack comes amid heightened tensions between Russia and Ukraine over naval activity.
sentences.zh: 此次袭击发生在俄罗斯与乌克兰因海军行动而加剧紧张局势之际。

sentences.en: Experts say the incident could provoke a diplomatic response from Russia.
sentences.zh: 专家表示此事件可能引发俄罗斯的外交回应。

sentences.en: Finnish media are monitoring the situation closely as more details emerge.
sentences.zh: 芬兰媒体正密切关注情况，随着更多细节出现。

sentences.en: The incident highlights the risks faced by commercial vessels in conflict zones.
sentences.zh: 此事件凸显了冲突地区商业船只面临的风险。

sentences.en: Observers will watch for any retaliation or escalation in the Baltic Sea region.
sentences.zh: 观察者将关注波罗的海地区是否有报复或升级。

focus.text: escalation in the Baltic Sea region

quiz.q: Which country is the ship heading to?
What type of weapon was used in the attack?

articles.title: Ukraine President Calls Bridge Strikes a Fair Response
articles.titleZh: 乌克兰总统称桥梁袭击是公平回应
articles.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统称，基辅在俄罗斯对乌克兰桥梁的109次空袭后采取行动。

sentences.en: President Zelenskiy said the strikes on the Crimean Bridge were a fair response to Russian attacks.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基总统表示，对克里米亚桥的袭击是对俄罗斯攻击的公平回应。

focus.note: 常用来形容适当的反击

sentences.en: He met with UK Foreign Secretary Jeremy Streeting to discuss the situation in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他与英国外交大臣杰里米·斯特里廷会面，讨论乌克兰局势。

sentences.en: Zelenskiy highlighted that Kyiv had faced 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges across the country.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基强调，基辅已面临俄罗斯对全国桥梁的109次单独空袭。

sentences.en: He said that the Ukrainian military had responded with precision strikes to protect critical infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 他表示乌克兰军方已以精准打击回应，以保护关键基础设施。

sentences.en: The UK government praised Ukraine's resilience and offered additional military support.
sentences.zh: 英国政府赞扬乌克兰的韧性，并提供额外的军事支持。

focus.note: 形容国家或个人的坚韧

sentences.en: Zelenskiy urged the international community to continue sanctions against Russia.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基敦促国际社会继续对俄罗斯实施制裁。

sentences.en: He emphasized that every strike on a bridge would further weaken Russia's war effort.
sentences.zh: 他强调，每一次桥梁袭击都会进一步削弱俄罗斯的战争努力。

focus.meaning: 削弱俄罗斯的战争努力

sentences.en: The meeting concluded with a pledge to coordinate future actions and share intelligence.
sentences.zh: 会议以承诺协调未来行动并共享情报结束。

sentences.en: Observers note that this exchange signals stronger ties between Ukraine and the UK.
sentences.zh: 观察人士指出，这次交流表明乌克兰与英国关系更紧密。

sentences.en: The next step will be monitoring the impact of these strikes on Russia's logistics network.
sentences.zh: 下一步将是监测这些袭击对俄罗斯物流网络的影响。

quiz.q: How many Russian aerial attacks on bridges did Ukraine face according to Zelenskiy?
quiz.explainZh: 泽连斯基提到的数字是109次。

quiz.q: Which UK official met with Zelenskiy?
quiz.explainZh: 会议对象是英国外交大臣杰里米·斯特里廷。

articles.title: Bank of England Directors Profited from Post‑Abolition Enslavement in Cuba
articles.titleZh: 英国银行董事从古巴废奴后奴役中获利
articles.summaryZh: 英国银行董事在奴隶制废除后，利用古巴奴隶劳工为英国工业发展谋利，显示奴隶贸易财富深植英国金融体系。

sentences.en: New research shows that directors of the Bank of England illegally profited from slavery in Cuba after it was officially abolished.
sentences.zh: 新的研究显示，英国银行董事在古巴奴隶制正式废除后非法获利。
sentences.tip: 主干：research shows that directors...；听：注意连读 and weak forms of 'that' and 'in'

sentences.en: The profits came from the Cobre Mining Company, a British‑led firm that extracted copper in Cuba.
sentences.zh: 利润来自英国主导的Cobre矿业公司，该公司在古巴提取铜矿。
sentences.tip: 主干：profits came from the Cobre Mining Company；听：关注 'came from' 的弱化和 'Cobre' 的发音

sentences.en: Copper from El Cobre mine supplied British factories during the Industrial Revolution.
sentences.zh: El Cobre矿的铜为英国工业革命期间的工厂提供原料。
sentences.tip: 主干：Copper from El Cobre mine supplied...；听：注意 'El Cobre' 的连读和 'supplied' 的弱化

sentences.en: Workers at El Cobre were enslaved men and boys kept in prison conditions.
sentences.zh: El Cobre的工人是被囚禁条件下的奴隶男子和男孩。
sentences.tip: 主干：Workers at El Cobre were enslaved...；听：注意 'were enslaved' 的弱化和 'prison conditions' 的强调

sentences.en: These conditions were brutal, with little food, harsh labor, and no freedom.
sentences.zh: 这些条件残酷，食物稀少，劳动艰辛，毫无自由。
sentences.tip: 主干：These conditions were brutal...；听：关注 'brutal' 的重读和 'no freedom' 的弱化

sentences.en: The wealth from this exploitation entered Britain’s banks, enriching the country’s financial system.
sentences.zh: 这种剥削的财富进入英国银行，丰富了国家的金融体系。
sentences.tip: 主干：The wealth from this exploitation entered...；听：注意 'wealth' 的重读和 'entered' 的弱化

sentences.en: Bank of England directors, many of whom served for decades, benefited from these profits.
sentences.zh: 英国银行董事，许多人任职数十年，从这些利润中获益。
sentences.tip: 主干：Bank of England directors...；听：注意 'benefited from' 的弱化和 'decades' 的重读

sentences.en: The study highlights how slavery’s legacy still shapes modern finance.
sentences.zh: 该研究凸显奴隶制遗产仍在塑造现代金融。
sentences.tip: 主干：The study highlights how...；听：注意 'legacy' 的弱化和 'still shapes' 的重读

sentences.en: Future investigations will look at other banks and companies linked to slave‑trade profits.
sentences.zh: 未来调查将关注与奴隶贸易利润相关的其他银行和公司。
sentences.tip: 主干：Future investigations will look at...；听：注意 'investigations' 的弱化和 'linked to' 的连读

sentences.en: This research urges a re‑examination of Britain’s financial history and its moral responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 这项研究敦促重新审视英国金融史及其道德责任。
sentences.tip: 主干：This research urges a re‑examination...；听：注意 're‑examination' 的重读和 'moral responsibilities' 的弱化

quiz.q: Which company was responsible for extracting copper used by British factories?
quiz.explainZh: 研究指出，Cobre矿业公司在古巴提取铜矿，供应英国工业。

quiz.q: What type of labor conditions were described at the El Cobre mine?
quiz.explainZh: 文章说明El Cobre矿的工人是被囚禁条件下的奴隶。
